_note: Names dropped by hand, each with its reason. Group "all": dropped from EVERY list, because the gate reads the lists together and a word left in another language's list would bring it back: care and everyday words that are almost never a name (baby, female, infant, walker, salud, vida ...). A language group ("pl", "es"): dropped from that language's list only: a word that is also a real given name in another list stays there, even where it is an ordinary word in the language of the group (Asma, Line, Santa): a missed name is the worse mistake, and the over-redaction of a title-case topic is a stated cost. Keys are lower case.

all.baby: Ontario's registrations hold "Baby" for an unnamed newborn (22,709 births): a placeholder, not a name, and an everyday care word
all.elder: an English care word ("elder care") held as a rare name
all.female: a care word ("Screening for Female Patients"), not a name
all.infant: a care word ("Care plan for Infant Feeding"), not a name
all.junior: an English word held as a rare name (a suffix of a name, not a name)
all.male: a care word ("Screening for Male Patients"), not a name
all.not: an ordinary word that registrations hold as a rare name
all.real: an ordinary word that registrations hold as a rare name
all.salud: "health": "Plan de cuidados para Salud Mental", "para Salud Pública"; Salud as a name is rare next to the word
all.vida: "life" in a title ("Resumen para Vida Diaria", "Calidad de Vida"), not a name
all.walker: a mobility aid ("Assessment for Walker Use")
all.ward: a hospital ward ("Plan for Ward Round")

pl.inna: an ordinary Polish word ("another"); documented false positive in pasteBackForms.test.ts

es.mama: "breast" ("Plan para Mama Derecha"); Mama stays in the other lists where it is a name
es.santa: "saint" in a Spanish place or institution ("Informe para Santa Casa"); Santa stays in the other languages' lists where it is a name
es.santo: "saint" in a Spanish place or institution ("Plan para Santo Hospital"); Santo stays in the other lists where it is a name
